name: My Werewolf Curse 2
source:
You’re now 18 years of age, and the time has come for the annual Mates Ball – a time when you can meet your mate. But what happens when an old nemesis suddenly appears?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

你现在已经18岁了，一年一度的伴侣舞会已经到了——你可以在这个时候见到你的伴侣。但当老对手突然出现时会发生什么呢？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
